purpose: Verify authenticated employee can submit a valid maintenance complaint and record is persisted.
preconditions: User is authenticated as an institute employee.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/ with valid title, description, location, category='civil', priority='medium'.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; complaint record created with status='draft' and requester username set.

purpose: Verify complaint submission validates mandatory fields (issue category, location, priority).
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/ with empty title, empty location, and negative estimated cost.
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; validation errors returned for title, location, or cost.

purpose: Verify submitting employee can track status of submitted complaints.
preconditions: Complaint exists in the system submitted by user 'emp_01'.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns list of complaints including the submitted ticket and current status.

purpose: Verify complaint assignment to an engineer and engineer visibility of assigned complaints.
action_or_input: Assign complaint to 'eng_civil_01' and GET /api/v1/iwd/requests/ filtering by assigned engineer.
expected_result: Assigned engineer field is updated and complaint appears in assigned engineer query.

purpose: Verify engineer can submit repair estimate covering estimated cost and target completion date.
preconditions: Complaint exists and is assigned to engineer.
action_or_input: Update work request with estimated_cost=15000 and valid future required_by date.
expected_result: Estimated cost and required_by date are updated on the record.

purpose: Verify estimate cost classification into low-cost band (< Rs. 25,000).
action_or_input: Check cost band classification logic for estimate below Rs. 25,000.
expected_result: Classified as low-cost estimate eligible for administrative review.

purpose: Verify approval of low-cost estimate by authorized supervisor.
preconditions: Work request is in 'submitted' and transitioned to 'under_review'.

purpose: Verify mid-range repair review and escalation handling.
preconditions: Work request has estimated_cost=75000 in 'under_review' status.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/{id}/hold/ with review note 'Referred for committee feasibility review'.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status transitions to 'on_hold' with review note logged.

purpose: Verify high-cost project requires Director-level approval authorization threshold.
preconditions: Work request has estimated cost exceeding Rs. 1,00,000.
expected_result: Returns True, indicating mandatory Director approval gate.

purpose: Verify rejected estimate retains rejection reason and supports resubmission.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/{id}/reject/ with note='Exceeds allocated sub-head budget'.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status='rejected'; audit log captures rejection note.

purpose: Verify maintenance inventory tracking, stock queries, and low stock detection.
preconditions: Inventory items exist with quantity below and above minimum stock.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns only items where quantity_available <= minimum_stock.

purpose: Verify work execution progress tracking from approved to in_progress.
Verify complete audit trail logging of all state changes and actor usernames.
preconditions: Work request underwent draft -> submit -> review transitions.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns chronological log entries with from_status, to_status, actor_username, and timestamps.

purpose: Verify completed work order closure and post-completion status lock.
Verify recording of actual expenditure upon work completion.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status='completed' and actual_cost is persisted as 14200.00.

purpose: Verify accredited contractor directory management and active filter.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/contractors/ with name, registration number, contact person, phone, email.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; contractor is saved with is_active=True.

purpose: Verify disallowance of skipping workflow states (e.g., draft directly to approved).
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; transition rejected by state machine.
